description: This source file implements DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and a proxy function for decrypting opaque content, specifically related to the PlayReady DRM system. It includes functions for initialization, deinitialization, and a decrypt proxy that interacts with external DRM and AV buffer handle conversion functions.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success status.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success status.

methods.description: Proxy function that calls DRM's decrypt function, converts a secure pointer to a handle, and manages error conditions, returning the result.
